description: Terminal record of a yobel debt release. Aggregates the (creditor, debtor) enrollment pair with the on-chain USDC release transaction via ERC725 Paymaster. Per CLAUDE.md `Schema invariant`: releasedMicroUsdc MUST NOT exceed debt.principalMicroUsdc + debt.accruedMicroUsdc (boundary check enforced by schema constraint + audit_witness double-gate). `releaseMethod` STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDES liquidation / seizure / margin_call (the schema-level utility-decreasing direction is closed). Per ADR-2605201800.

debtId.description: References enrollCreditor.debts[].debtId. MUST be one of the historical debts in the parent creditor enrollment.

principalMicroUsdc.description: Mirror of enrollCreditor.debts[].principalMicroUsdc. Repeated here so this terminal record is self-contained for audit.

releasedMicroUsdc.description: Amount actually released. MUST be ≤ principalMicroUsdc + accruedMicroUsdc per CLAUDE.md `Schema invariant`. Validator enforces this; audit_witness cell double-gates.

releaseMethod.description: Release method. The schema STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDES `liquidation`, `seizure`, `margin_call`, and any utility-decreasing direction (Charter Rider §2(b) one-way enforcement).

baseL2TxHash.description: On-chain Base L2 USDC release transaction hash via ERC725 Paymaster.

erc725PaymasterAddress.description: ERC725 Paymaster contract that funded the release tx.

titheRouterAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the TitheRouter.route() attestation (10% reverse-neutral for releases per CLAUDE.md `Settlement` row + ADR-2605192130).

auditWitnessAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the audit_witness cell's encrypted append-only log entry for this release event.

supersededByReleaseId.description: If this release was later marked superseded by audit_witness tampering detection (per CLAUDE.md `Witness invariant`), the replacement releaseId. Audit-only field; rare path.
